tasks.goal: Build a single-file Node.js HTTP server with no external dependencies that exposes a JSON CRUD API for managing a recipe box (title, ingredients, steps) backed by an in-memory store, printing the listening port on startup.

Given an entry file and README describing a book club tracker's create/read/list/delete JSON routes, write and run a script that exercises each route end-to-end and checks the status codes and response bodies match the documented spec.

Given an HTML/JS file for a thermostat control widget that exposes a window.__thermostat state object with getters, write a script that mechanically checks the temperature controls and the conditional heating/cooling color styling react correctly to state changes.
